afterLabels: While this is off, heyta sends data nowhere.
While this is off, only on-device endpoints are used (data does not leave this device).

Inferred from your own history (breakdown granularity, phrasing habits, time-estimate bias, and so on). Inference happens only on this device and is never uploaded; with it off, AI still works, it just does not know you.
heyta hosted (our cloud AI, billed with your subscription)
heyta hosted (our cloud AI, billed with your subscription)

The hosted option uses the server address you entered under Sync — change the server and this follows, no need to edit it here. ⚠️ On the hosted path your task content is decrypted on our server before it reaches the model (end-to-end encryption does not cover that path); my own endpoint never goes through us.
No endpoints yet. You can add an on-device endpoint - it needs no consent and data does not leave the device.
On-device Ollama：Install Ollama first and pull a model (for example ollama pull qwen3:8b).
On-device LM Studio：Turn on the local server inside LM Studio (default port 1234).
The key stays on this device: never backed up, never synced, cleared when you log out.
Pick which endpoint serves which feature.List order is try order (earlier ones are tried first).
At most these fields can leave the device:
Can create, update, or complete tasks; low-risk writes run automatically, while high-risk changes ask first.
A new endpoint starts at “Execute”; you can change it any time.
Let other programs on this machine (editors, scripts, AI assistants) read and write your tasks.Off by default, and each tool must be enabled separately.
Listens only on 127.0.0.1 and is not exposed to the local network.

steps.name: open general group
afterLabels: Today's tasks, quadrants, habits and focus — four cards you can keep on your home screen.
Today's tasks · Quadrants · Today's habits · Today's focus
Touch and hold an empty spot on the home screen until the icons jiggle
Tap the “+” in the top-left corner
Search for “Heyta” and pick a size
The system does not let an app place a widget for you, so you add it once by hand.
If the card says “Open Heyta to show your widget” after adding it, opening Heyta once fills it in.
Credentials are kept in memory only and must be re-entered after the app fully exits.
This device remembers your choice, and it still applies after you reopen the app. Your home-screen widgets read the same preference.
Complaints and reports, Opens your mail app with a message to our intake mailbox
